recreation_brief: 1. Set the slide background to white. 2. Add a title text box at the top-left with the exact text 'F-Score for different Precision and Recall values' in bold red sans-serif, about 28-32 pt. 3. Add a yellow oval at the top-right with a black outline and the text '17' in black, centered. 4. Insert a line chart with markers sized to fill the center/lower slide; use a white plot area, light-gray chart area, and a thin red chart border. 5. Set the X axis title to 'recall', range 0.0-1.0, major ticks every 0.2; set the Y axis title to 'F1', range 0.0-1.0, major ticks every 0.2. 6. Add ten series named exactly 'precision = 0.1' through 'precision = 1'; use the colors and marker shapes listed in the chart description and plot the marker values listed there at recall = 0.0,0.1,...,1.0. 7. Place the legend inside the plot at the top-left with small black text and no border. 8. Overlay dashed green lines at F1 approx 0.18 with vertical drops at recall approx 0.1 and 1.0, and dashed red lines at F1 approx 0.45 with vertical drops at recall approx 0.6 and 1.0. 9. Keep all other slide areas empty.
